lines.say: The face you were born with was only on lease. It expires on Friday.
Renewal costs nine thousand dollars. Or you get a free basic face.
Half your building already has the basic face. Grey. They all look the same.
Friday. Your face fades in the mirror.
That night you see a billboard on the tower. A new model. Smiling. With your face.
Would you pay to keep your face? Write it in the comments.
